en: Auntie! More milk!

jp: ガブガブ飲むのはいいけれど
お腹だけは繊細なんだから
en: Guzzle away, but you'll upset your stomach again. It's your one delicate spot.

jp: 俺にも飲みたくなる時があるんだ
en: Even I feel like a drink sometimes.

jp: ミルク片手に言っても
en: Doesn't quite land with a glass of milk in your hand.
...Huh? Come to think of it, where's Johannes?

jp: さっきまでそこにいたはずだよ？
en: That's odd. He was right there a moment ago.

jp: あいつなら広場でみかけたぞ
en: Saw him in the square.
Oh, welcome back, you two.
...Welcome back?

jp: 外から誰かが戻ってきたら
en: When someone comes home from outside, you say "welcome back", don't you?

jp: ・・・そういう言葉を聞くと
あんたがどんな環境で
育ったのか想像がつくわね
en: ...Hearing words like that, I can just picture the kind of place you grew up.

jp: 収穫はなかったみたいだな
en: From the look of you, no luck.
...Shut up.
...Matia. I wonder if she's doing okay.

jp: 犬っぽいって言われない？
en: Ha ha ha, hey, anyone ever tell you you're like a dog?
A dog?

jp: 玄関先でご主人の帰りを待つ犬
マティアの名前を呟く時って
そんな目をしてるよな
en: A dog at the door waiting for its master. That's your face when you say Matia's name.
I do not!
Pfft.

jp: ザイオンまでうけてるぜ
en: See, see? Even Zion's cracking up.

jp: ひどいよザイオンまで！
ボクはそんなんじゃ・・・
en: Not you too, Zion! I'm not like that...

jp: じゃれ合ってる暇があったら
外にでも行って運動してきな
en: All right, puppies. If you've time to scuffle, go outside and get some exercise.
The other puppy... me?

jp: 他に誰がいるってんだい
さぁさぁ、行った行った
en: Who else would it be? Now off you go, shoo.

jp: ちゃんと目を通すんだよ
en: There should be new entries in the Notebook by now, so be sure to read them.
Here, this too.

jp: サイファーパンクからの支給品
忘れずに持って行きなさい
en: Supplies from Cypherpunk. Don't forget to take them with you.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
